faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Wapsell is an all-in-one sales platform that integrates WhatsApp, product catalog, contact management, and business analytics in a single tool.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a2: No. Wapsell runs entirely in the cloud. Just access it from your browser.
faq.q3: Can I import my existing catalog?
faq.a3: Yes. You can easily import your products from a CSV file or enter them manually.
faq.a4: Each customer message counts as a conversation. Outgoing messages don't count. You have a limit based on your plan.
faq.a5: We offer email and chat support. Premium plans include priority support.
